title: Save one local recursive BIT query by changing carrier compensation
body:
## Summary

Changing the downstream compensation of the actual PR4068 helper413/444 packet saves **one query in the complete local recursive-query bill: 2913 → 2912**, while saving **58 unit ADDs: 36005 → 35947**. Source50 is delivered directly to413 after a closed COPY episode; helper469 keeps its arbitrary dirt and fully paid width-eight terminal residual.

The retired route has ranks `1,6,1`; the replacement has ranks `7,1`. The complete histogram delta is `e7-e6-e1`, with unchanged rank mass 5101, all 438 helper roles and all nine COPY/ERASE pairs. Every child rank remains below the local dimension 8. For `Phi_m(r)=m^b*r^(1-b)`, the saving is `Phi_m(1)+Phi_m(6)-Phi_m(7)>0` for `m>0, 0<b<1`.

[Proof and literal recipe](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/928066009267fb32ab2c1a29b50fa3093ea18aef/research/bit-delayed-carrier-retirement/PROOF.md) · [Scope, receipts and reproduction](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/928066009267fb32ab2c1a29b50fa3093ea18aef/research/bit-delayed-carrier-retirement/README.md).

## Scope and limits

This is an exact finite stream construction with a fully charged local query comparison. **Physical owner/controller admission, routing, rounded-child cleanup and all-size outer assembly remain open; no new kappa is claimed.** Both original rank-two queries on413 and444 remain. Helper469 retains its original physical `D_FULL` residual; decoded restoration is not physical identity.

The Boolean construction changes the signed public lift by `-2 h469` on 51 targets. A separately verified variant preserves every integer output row, uses 36049 unit ADDs, and retains the same query saving.

User-assigned changed-consumer follow-up, with catalogue card `bit-new-register-model` used only as provenance. Scientific base: `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`.

- [PR4068](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4068), head `5a34918402ae2c0c683d8820ad832970e77f6382`: frozen shared-source packet; unchanged.
- [PR4021](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4021), head `c01f97ecfc7fa64847f6abd8f7b231e1df8c7b70`: byte-identical five-terminal input archives.
- [PR4179](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4179), head `de9deae2b787143923c0a504fbcc3871d01cff0b`: the fixed complete-join pair floor remains intact; this changes the downstream carrier and compensation.

The earlier 444/470 kernel entrance and R437 carrier rewrites have different contracts. `OVERLAP.json` records the bounded live search of 302 open PRs and 2698 discussions with complete pagination; title/body and local-metadata coverage is not a novelty certificate.

The next admission obligation is to bind the eight retimed/inserted events to a concrete chronological owner/controller. For the common source92 carrier470, the retained COPY478/target128 dependency blocks the same direct timing; its explicitly restored out-and-back route loses, so a different reader contract would be needed. See the README and `TASK.json` for the scoped next questions.

## Test plan

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-delayed-carrier-retirement
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-delayed-carrier-retirement --check-source-history
```

Two separately implemented checkers reconstruct both variants and agree on literal word hashes and invoices. Coverage includes all 660 independent columns, exact source/helper rows, Boolean public outputs, the complete integer control, both inverse orders, COPY snapshots, no recursive MOVE inside a live COPY, 636 dyadic projectors and exact relative address maps. Eight defect controls cover source delivery, terminal restoration, compensation, timing, private dirt and an underpriced query.

The registered hook runs ordinary and optimized Python with full typed receipt comparison. The committed export is also replayed in both modes from an inode-disjoint, read-only, Git-free tree. The exact price interval has a separate integer 500th-power check. These are local finite certificates and a written arbitrary-function frame proof, not formal-kernel or physical compiler verification. Hosted CI is reported separately.

## Sources and credit

Retain Ali Romman's R438/PR1043 source substitution, Sagar Thakrar's transported word/window analysis, PR540/589 frame semantics and hosting, PR1023 width conventions, and the five-terminal predecessor. Controller credit includes DreamingOfClouds, Zhihao Chen, eumemic and chafreaky. The README also credits Adam Gall's earlier kernel entrance and Chris R / Clear1nsight's R437 carrier work.

Ross Richardson, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in construction, implementation, writing and separate AI review. No independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
